comment: Castrum Meridianum's BNpcBase 14570: what it did in three retail runs (Connor's Chronofoil capture af05916c (2026-11-09, visit 0.8) and Bob's 9ba7d981 (visit 0.12) and 50e72631 (visit 0.3) of 2026-11-17, all with Duty Support; `questkit sources --duty 15`: its rotation's pace and each action's median amounts). A draft from Bob's Chronofoil captures (50e72631, 9ba7d981, af05916c), not yet checked in game: ContentFinderCondition 15, BNpcBase 14570, BNpcName 2107, level 50, 7663 HP, 9 seen in 3 runs. `players` and `npcs` are the median damage to each, `every` the median time between uses.

actions.comment: 5 uses; 2.2 s cast. Retail (questkit rates, 2026-11-21: 8 casts by 8 of the duty fixtures' NPCs): first 14 to 42.8 s after the pull (median 35; `first_uses`: each NPC draws one of retail's each fight), `every` 73 s (never twice by one: the longest any of them fought). Before, the rotation would have cast it 121 times at most over lives retail's cast it 8.
